title: Nonempty affine opens of an integral locally algebraic scheme have equal dimension
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] whose structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $V,W\subseteq X$ be nonempty open subsets such that the open subschemes $(V,\mathcal O_X|_V)$ and $(W,\mathcal O_X|_W)$ are affine, i.e. isomorphic to spectra of commutative rings [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $\dim V=\dim W$, where $\dim$ is the Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of the subset with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology].
